declarations.name: GDT.Challenge.accepted_iff_coprime_R
declarations.source_statement: lemma accepted_iff_coprime_R {N m : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hm : 0 < m) {a : ℤ} (h : Admissible N m a) (n : ℕ) : accepted N m a n ↔ (n : ℤ) ≡ a [ZMOD (m : ℤ)] ∧ Nat.gcd n (R N m) = 1
declarations.elaborated_type:
∀ {N m : ℕ},
  0 < N →
    0 < m → ∀ {a : ℤ}, GDT.Admissible N m a → ∀ (n : ℕ), GDT.accepted N m a n ↔ ↑n ≡ a [ZMOD ↑m] ∧ n.gcd (GDT.R N m) = 1

declarations.name: GDT.Challenge.canonical_window_card_eq_range_coprime
declarations.source_statement: lemma canonical_window_card_eq_range_coprime {N m : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hm : 0 < m) {a : ℤ} (_h : Admissible N m a) : ((Finset.Ico 0 (Tmin N m)).filter (fun (n : ℕ) => (n : ℤ) ≡ a [ZMOD (m : ℤ)] ∧ Nat.gcd n (R N m) = 1)).card = ((Finset.range (R N m)).filter (fun r => Nat.gcd r (R N m) = 1)).card
declarations.elaborated_type:
∀ {N m : ℕ},
  0 < N →
    0 < m →
      ∀ {a : ℤ},
        GDT.Admissible N m a →
          {n ∈ Finset.Ico 0 (GDT.Tmin N m) | ↑n ≡ a [ZMOD ↑m] ∧ n.gcd (GDT.R N m) = 1}.card =
            {r ∈ Finset.range (GDT.R N m) | r.gcd (GDT.R N m) = 1}.card

declarations.name: GDT.Challenge.card_filter_Ico_split
declarations.source_statement: lemma card_filter_Ico_split {P : ℕ → Prop} [DecidablePred P] {a b c : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) : ((Finset.Ico a c).filter P).card = ((Finset.Ico a b).filter P).card + ((Finset.Ico b c).filter P).card
declarations.elaborated_type:
∀ {P : ℕ → Prop} [inst : DecidablePred P] {a b c : ℕ},
  a ≤ b →
    b ≤ c →
      (Finset.filter P (Finset.Ico a c)).card =
        (Finset.filter P (Finset.Ico a b)).card + (Finset.filter P (Finset.Ico b c)).card

declarations.source_statement: lemma exists_coprime_R_neg_t_mod_p {N m : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) {p t : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hpR : p ∣ R N m) (hpt : ¬ p ∣ t) : ∃ r, r < R N m ∧ Nat.Coprime r (R N m) ∧ (r : ℤ) ≡ -(t : ℤ) [ZMOD (p : ℤ)]

declarations.source_statement: theorem gdt_correction_factor {N m : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (_hm : 0 < m) : Nat.totient (R N m) * N * Nat.totient (d N m) = d N m * R N m * Nat.totient N
declarations.elaborated_type: ∀ {N m : ℕ}, 0 < N → 0 < m → (GDT.R N m).totient * N * (GDT.d N m).totient = GDT.d N m * GDT.R N m * N.totient

declarations.name: GDT.Challenge.gdt_density
declarations.source_statement: theorem gdt_density {N m q s : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hm : 0 < m) {a : ℤ} (h : Admissible N m a) (_hs : s < Tmin N m) : (S N (q * Tmin N m + s) m a).card = q * Nat.totient (R N m) + (S N s m a).card
declarations.elaborated_type:
∀ {N m q s : ℕ},
  0 < N →
    0 < m →
      ∀ {a : ℤ},
        GDT.Admissible N m a →
          s < GDT.Tmin N m → (GDT.S N (q * GDT.Tmin N m + s) m a).card = q * (GDT.R N m).totient + (GDT.S N s m a).card

declarations.name: GDT.Challenge.gdt_periodic
declarations.source_statement: theorem gdt_periodic {N m : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hm : 0 < m) {a : ℤ} (h : Admissible N m a) : IsPeriod N m a (Tmin N m)
declarations.elaborated_type: ∀ {N m : ℕ}, 0 < N → 0 < m → ∀ {a : ℤ}, GDT.Admissible N m a → GDT.IsPeriod N m a (GDT.Tmin N m)

declarations.name: GDT.Challenge.general_divisor_theorem
declarations.source_statement: theorem general_divisor_theorem {N m L : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hm : 0 < m) (a : ℤ) : (¬ Admissible N m a → S N L m a = ∅) ∧ (Admissible N m a → IsPeriod N m a (Tmin N m) ∧ (∀ t : ℕ, 0 < t → IsPeriod N m a t → Tmin N m ∣ t) ∧ (∀ b : ℕ, ((Finset.Ico b (b + Tmin N m)).filter (accepted N m a)).card = Nat.totient (R N m))) ∧ Nat.totient (R N m) * N * Nat.totient (d N m) = d N m * R N m * Nat.totient N
declarations.elaborated_type:
∀ {N m L : ℕ},
  0 < N →
    0 < m →
      ∀ (a : ℤ),
        (¬GDT.Admissible N m a → GDT.S N L m a = ∅) ∧
          (GDT.Admissible N m a →
              GDT.IsPeriod N m a (GDT.Tmin N m) ∧
                (∀ (t : ℕ), 0 < t → GDT.IsPeriod N m a t → GDT.Tmin N m ∣ t) ∧
                  ∀ (b : ℕ),
                    (Finset.filter (GDT.accepted N m a) (Finset.Ico b (b + GDT.Tmin N m))).card = (GDT.R N m).totient) ∧
            (GDT.R N m).totient * N * (GDT.d N m).totient = GDT.d N m * GDT.R N m * N.totient

declarations.name: GDT.Challenge.periodic_window_card_eq
declarations.source_statement: lemma periodic_window_card_eq {P : ℕ → Prop} [DecidablePred P] {T : ℕ} (hP : ∀ n, P (n + T) ↔ P n) (b : ℕ) : ((Finset.Ico b (b + T)).filter P).card = ((Finset.Ico 0 T).filter P).card
declarations.elaborated_type:
∀ {P : ℕ → Prop} [inst : DecidablePred P] {T : ℕ},
  (∀ (n : ℕ), P (n + T) ↔ P n) →
    ∀ (b : ℕ), (Finset.filter P (Finset.Ico b (b + T))).card = (Finset.filter P (Finset.Ico 0 T)).card

  0 < N →
    0 < m →
      ∀ {a : ℤ} {n1 n2 : ℕ},
        n1 < GDT.Tmin N m →
          n2 < GDT.Tmin N m → ↑n1 ≡ a [ZMOD ↑m] → ↑n2 ≡ a [ZMOD ↑m] → n1 % GDT.R N m = n2 % GDT.R N m → n1 = n2
